implementation_plan.rationale: L08 acceptance depends on machine-readable metrics, not permissive report shapes.

implementation_plan.step: Extend or add a large-rung fault/failover wrapper around real Valkey probes.
implementation_plan.rationale: Real proof must come from a wrapper that independently probes live Valkey endpoints and can drive scale_30, scale_50, and scale_100 scenarios safely.
Scale rungs run many Valkey processes inside owned nodehost containers; stopping one logical primary must target only the owned pid/container namespace recorded in state.

implementation_plan.step: Collect before/during/after workload and cluster windows.
implementation_plan.rationale: L08 requires availability and workload errors/timeouts around the fault from timestamped operation windows.

implementation_plan.step: Add L08 large-rung audit and coverage integration.
implementation_plan.rationale: 30/50/100 fault and failover cells must become covered only when backed by real L08 artifacts; P14 must remain dry-run-only.

acceptance_criteria: Previous harness remains PASS after L08 changes.

For each node count 30, 50, and 100, resource preflight either passes and the real fault/failover gate runs, or the stage records a BLOCKED result with the failing preflight artifact and does not claim PASS.
Each successful 30/50/100 rung emits fault_report_N.json, failover_report_N.json, workload_window_report_N.json, valkey_e2e_evidence_fault_N.json, and cleanup_report_fault_N.json.
Each valkey_e2e_evidence_fault_N artifact has real_valkey true, Valkey version prefix 9.1., wrapper producer identity, errors empty, and cleanup PASS.
Coverage matrix and metric catalog mark 30/50/100 fault and failover as real coverage only from L08 real artifacts.
P14/1000 remains opt-in dry-run/resource/planner only; no 1000-node real fault/failover gate is executed or counted.
risks: 30/50/100 primary-stop failover gates may exceed local Docker CPU, memory, port, or timeout limits.
docker_process runtime has multiple logical Valkey processes in owned nodehost containers; unsafe implementation could stop an entire nodehost.
Workload windows can be misleading if generated from aggregate workload_report values rather than timestamped operations.
Split-brain metrics may not be safely measurable with primary stop alone; explicit MISSING is acceptable only with a precise reason.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not run or count P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN, 1000-node real gates, or any 1000-node fault/failover scenario without explicit user opt-in and the required environment variable.
Do not mutate host network configuration, routing, firewall, PF, nftables, iptables, interfaces, or OS network services.
Do not kill host processes, host interfaces, unrelated containers, or all processes in a nodehost when only one logical Valkey node is targeted.
Do not claim project tests, generated logs, fake probes, or static artifacts as real Valkey evidence.
Do not fabricate missing metrics; use MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON with a reason.
Do not weaken harness controls, delete required schema fields, or edit gate_lock.json to hide changes.
commands_to_run: python3 -m pytest -q tests/integration tests/fault tests/failover tests/orchestrator
notes: Requirements are clear enough to proceed to harness design. The main open design point is how to stop one logical primary safely in docker_process scale scenarios.
